items.title: 7. Pressure due to Particle Collisions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 7. Pressure due to Particle Collisions: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: Gas bartan ki deewaron par jo pressure dalti hai woh particles ke deewaron se takrane ki wajah se hai. Takkar ke waqt particles jo force lagate hain wahi pressure banati hai.
